scenario: Select a reading position; user says their chair has no armrests.
mechanism: Remove armrest-dependent suggestion without assuming available furniture.

scenario: Learn the distinction between 'peek' and 'glance'; user wants examples about observing a surprise without spoiling it.
mechanism: Adapt examples while maintaining the difference in usage.

scenario: Plan a fictional detective scene where the detective cannot enter the house; discuss a witness and clue before drafting the investigation.
mechanism: Recall access boundary after two exchanges without inventing permission.

scenario: Consider a shared playlist disagreement; user clarifies both people want variety but disagree about volume.
mechanism: Identify the actual point of disagreement rather than inventing opposing tastes.

scenario: Troubleshoot a stubborn marker cap; user clarifies the cap comes off but will not stay on.
mechanism: Reverse the problem framing and offer cautious storage ideas.

scenario: Design a morning checklist; user prefers a flexible menu of options, not an ordered sequence.
mechanism: Convert mandatory steps into choices.

scenario: Discuss a short supplied proverb about patience; user asks for a possible limitation instead of another example.
mechanism: Shift from illustration to nuanced qualification.

scenario: Brainstorm a fictional celebration with no fireworks; discuss decorations and food before designing its finale.
mechanism: Recall exclusion after two complete intervening exchanges.

scenario: Help prepare for a conversation about unequal chores; user clarifies they have not yet agreed on who does what.
mechanism: Avoid describing a broken agreement and suggest an exploratory opening.

scenario: Choose a color palette for a handmade card; user changes preference from high contrast to muted colors while retaining legibility.
mechanism: Balance updated aesthetics and readability without assuming visual ability.

scenario: Suggest a low-noise indoor pastime; user clarifies they can use their hands but want to avoid screens.
mechanism: Refine activity options to the stated constraints.

scenario: Discuss the word 'overlook'; user means 'fail to notice,' not 'have a view of.'
mechanism: Resolve polysemy from the user's clarification.

scenario: Imagine a journey narrated by a suitcase that cannot see; discuss its owner and destination before writing the scene.
mechanism: Restrict narration to plausible nonvisual perceptions after two exchanges.

scenario: Reflect on missing an old routine; user explains they chose to change it and still feel sad.
mechanism: Hold agency and grief together without urging reversal.

scenario: Plan an unplugged storytelling game; user changes from individual turns to collaborative sentence-by-sentence telling.
mechanism: Revise participation structure while retaining the screen-free constraint.

scenario: Sort a box of cords; user says they cannot identify which devices some cords belong to.
mechanism: Group unknowns separately instead of inventing matches.

scenario: Discuss an ambiguous note saying 'leave it by the door'; user clarifies there are two doors and the writer has not specified one.
mechanism: Preserve ambiguity and propose a clarification question.

scenario: Plan a reading session with large-print materials; discuss genre and seating before selecting a format.
mechanism: Recall accessibility preference after two intervening exchanges without asserting availability.

scenario: Draft a fictional conversation between rivals; user decides their disagreement is affectionate rather than hostile.
mechanism: Change tone while retaining a real difference of opinion.

scenario: Think through a disappointing gathering; user explains they enjoyed the people but found the noise tiring.
mechanism: Separate social enjoyment from sensory discomfort.
